title: Finished lantern charge glow
desc: Three ways the charge light fills the lantern glass on the approved G3b timing; J: "the glow from the lantern charge should be much better by now".

takes.name: L1 port spread
takes.facts: light starts at the port and keeps spreading with the charge (front = (0.25 touch + 0.75 charge) x 26 px), brightest along the front; G3b rules: ring docks at frame 60, 12 s to full, 2 s overcharge, hold, 7.5 s fade; 680 frames at 24 fps (window shows full > climax > hold > fade start)

takes.name: L2 band climb
takes.facts: fills bottom-up like a rising level (3 px + charge x 78% of the height), brightest under the surface; overcharge tips over the top; G3b rules: ring docks at frame 60, 12 s to full, 2 s overcharge, hold, 7.5 s fade; 680 frames at 24 fps (window shows full > climax > hold > fade start)

takes.name: L3 core swirl
takes.facts: strands round the core 3x as strong and spinning twice as fast; the heart flares more; G3b rules: ring docks at frame 60, 12 s to full, 2 s overcharge, hold, 7.5 s fade; 680 frames at 24 fps (window shows full > climax > hold > fade start)
